narrative.overview:
Dimky presents the day as a readable schedule on a deep navy canvas. Warm amber marks primary actions, studied time, and the active block; medium purple brings planned time, selected durations, and focus guidance forward. The established dark palette stays familiar while its two accents carry clear, consistent roles.

The Android app follows Material 3 for navigation, controls, and semantic color pairing. Agenda rows remain light and time ordered; grouped surfaces organize summaries and settings without turning every item into a card. System text scaling and Android navigation behavior remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy surfaces create the app's persistent night setting.
Warm amber identifies primary actions, studied time, and active blocks.
Medium purple highlights planned time, selected durations, and focus guidance.
Explicit labels accompany color-coded completion and restriction states.
Material 3 controls preserve familiar Android interaction behavior.

rules.name: The Role-First Rule
rules.body: Use Material semantic roles with their paired foregrounds; do not hard-code a one-off foreground against a semantic surface.

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the vivid signal for primary actions, studied time, and the current agenda treatment. Keep it off decorative elements and pair it with readable dark text.

rules.name: The Fixed-Night Rule
rules.body: Keep the established dark palette across app screens; do not substitute a light or wallpaper-derived scheme.

rules.name: The Role-Based Type Rule
rules.body: Use Material type roles and scalable `sp` units; reserve serif and monospace accents for the existing time-led hierarchy.

rules.name: The Time-First Rule
rules.body: Sort blocks by start time and make each time label scannable beside its activity and state.

rules.name: The Flat-Board Rule
rules.body: Use tonal depth and fine dividers to organize the schedule, not custom drop shadows.

dos: **Do** keep time, activity, and completion state readable together.
**Do** use the fixed dark semantic colors from `FocusTheme`.
**Do** use amber for primary actions and studied time, and medium purple for secondary emphasis and planned time.
**Do** pair status colors with visible text labels.
**Do** preserve Android touch targets, system Back, and font scaling.
donts: **Don't** replace the established palette with a new color family or dynamic wallpaper color.
**Don't** use amber as general decoration or as the only status cue.
**Don't** rely on a transient animation as the only signal of a changed or current state.
**Don't** add decorative shadows to the mostly flat timetable.
**Don't** use error red for a normal incomplete or not-started state.
